page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a decorative printed banner at the head, a title and subtitle in capitals and italic, and a woodcut initial D opening the first paragraph. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right. Printed page number and gathering mark at the foot.

p.i: Duo mihi proposui hoc in opere: unum, ut animum meum exuerem opinionibus philosophicis, quae non possunt non adhaerescere iis, qui vulgarium philosophorum scripta, sepositis Scripturis sacris, euoluunt, eaq; sibi proponunt canonem:alterum, ut Biblia sacra in locos communes ita redigerem, ut inde systema methodicum conficerem, pandectasq; [?] illas sacras iuuentuti eo familiariores redderem. Cùm vero primam [?] hâc in re glaciem fregerim, veniam mihi dari peto. Satis mihi fuerit, si hoc assecutus fuero, ut praeceptores & discipuli tandem aliquando intelligant, à Bibliis sacris esse incipiendum, inque illis desinendum. Ita enim fiet, ut non solùm

page.notes: The initial D is a woodcut; read as D before "uo" (printed "Vo"). The word "primam" is partly obscured by a blot at the line end, so the last letters are doubtful. The abbreviation "pandectasq;" is partly illegible in the scan. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible above the title and was omitted. The running head is absent on this page, as it opens the preface.
